description: Department of Forest Conservation - Declare that Urani Kottngal Mangrove Forest as reserved forest in Ampara District
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of mangrove forests as reserved forests under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, which constitutes a regulatory/legal action. It references specific legal provisions (Section 3, Section 64(1), Chapter 451) and various amending acts, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, land ownership, or other specialized categories. While it mentions the President by name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment.
